tip.title: Send the link on the day of the first contact.
tip.body: With the move still fresh, it's easier for the client to remember everything they're taking.

body: To prepare the quote for your move, tell us what you'll take and what the access is like. You don't need to create an account and you can do it bit by bit:
The link is active for {days} days.

new.title: New order
new.subtitle: Just the essentials to get started. The customer fills in the rest through the link: what they're taking, photos and access.

client.title: Customer
client.phoneHint: Start with the phone number: if the customer already exists, we suggest their details.
client.name: Name
client.namePlaceholder: First and last name, or company name
client.emailHint: With an email, the customer gets a copy of the accepted proposal and the handover reports.
client.linked: Linked to an existing customer record

suggestion.title: This number is already a customer: {name}

inventory.title: Who fills in the inventory?

link.title: The customer, via the link
link.text: They list what they're taking, with photos and access, without creating an account. You get a notice when they send it.

self.title: Me, now or during a visit
self.text: By phone or at the customer's home. It's recorded as filled in by the company.

inventory.validityNote: After that, the customer sees a notice and can no longer edit.

side.messageFooter: Sent by WhatsApp, SMS or email in the next step.

afterLink.title: You share the link
afterLink.text: Copy it or send it by WhatsApp, SMS or email.

afterLink.title: The customer fills it in
afterLink.text: They can do it bit by bit; the draft is saved.

afterLink.title: You get a notice
afterLink.text: With the inventory received, you prepare the proposal.

afterSelf.title: You open the inventory
afterSelf.text: Room by room, with the object catalog.

afterSelf.title: You prepare the proposal
afterSelf.text: The calculation uses the inventory you filled in.

inventory.noMeasures: No measurements. It does not count towards the volume until estimated.
inventory.emptyText: Once the client sends the inventory through the link, or you fill it in, it shows up here.

side.canEdit: {name} can change the inventory until a proposal is accepted.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.inactiveNote: Not used in proposals or the schedule

help.label: How the fleet is used in proposals
help.title: How the fleet is used in proposals
help.text: The calculation picks the smallest combination of active vehicles that carries the adjusted volume. If nothing fits, it proposes extra trips. An inactive vehicle does not appear in proposals or in the schedule.

capacity.text: This month they needed an extra trip. A larger vehicle could lower the price.

text.one: Used in only {count} proposal this month. Check it is still needed.
text.other: Used in only {count} proposals this month. Check it is still needed.

cost.text: Without it, the cost and margin of proposals are wrong.

table.title: Fleet vehicles
table.inactiveHint: not used in proposals or the schedule
table.footnote: "In proposals": proposals from the last 30 days where the calculation picked the vehicle, and how many were accepted.

pendingJobs.one: It has {count} job scheduled on {date} ({orderId}). Reassign it before deactivating or it will be left without a vehicle.
pendingJobs.other: It has {count} jobs scheduled, the next on {date} ({orderId}). Reassign them before deactivating or they will be left without a vehicle.

data.title: Vehicle details
data.costMissing: Without a cost per km, the cost and margin of proposals are wrong.
data.privacy: Cost per km is only visible to administrators. Changes do not affect proposals already sent.

usage.title: Use in {month}

history.title: History

empty.hint: Start with the vehicle you use most often.
empty.perksTitle: What you'll be able to do

capacity.title: The right capacity
capacity.text: Know how many vehicles and trips each move needs.

costs.title: Clearer costs
costs.text: The cost per km goes into your proposals and shows the real margin.

schedule.title: An organised schedule
schedule.text: See each vehicle's availability and avoid double bookings.

empty.later: You can add the rest of your vehicles later.

new.title: New vehicle
new.subtitle: Only the essentials are required. You can fill in the rest whenever you like.
new.added: {plate} added to the fleet. You can add the next one.

type.title: What type of vehicle is it?
type.subtitle: We use the type to suggest usual values. You confirm them next.

identification.title: Identification
identification.name: Short name
identification.nameHint: What the team calls it. Shown in the schedule and in internal proposals.

capacity.title: Capacity and costs
capacity.subtitle: What the calculation uses to choose vehicles and work out the cost of each move.
capacity.suggestion: Usual values for a {type}. Check them against your vehicle.
capacity.privacy: Cost per km: fuel, tolls and wear. It goes into the cost and margin of proposals and only administrators can see it.

availability.title: Availability
availability.label: Available for proposals and the schedule
availability.on: It enters the calculation and the schedule as soon as you save.
availability.off: It's saved, but stays out of proposals and the schedule until you activate it.

documents.title: Documents and deadlines
documents.text: Inspection, insurance and services, with a reminder before they expire.

photos.title: Photos
photos.text: So the team can recognise the vehicle and record its condition.

maintenance.title: Maintenance and expenses
maintenance.text: Workshop, fuel and real cost per km.

preview.title: How it appears in the fleet

impact.title: What changes in proposals
impact.needCapacity: Enter the capacity to see how this vehicle fits into proposals.
impact.active: Moves up to {capacity} m³ can go in this vehicle alone, and larger ones get more possible combinations.
impact.inactive: While inactive, it doesn't count for proposals.

errors.plateInvalid: Invalid plate. Use the format AA-00-AA.
errors.plateTaken: There's already a vehicle with this plate in your fleet.

errors.maxLoadInvalid: Invalid load. Enter whole kg, up to 40,000.
errors.costInvalid: Invalid cost. Enter a value between €0.01 and €20 per km.

help.label: How the team is used in proposals
help.title: How the team is used in proposals
help.text: The calculation estimates how many crew members each move needs and uses the hourly cost from the rate card, the same for everyone. Only active people appear in the schedule.
help.app: Crew members use the phone app: they only see the jobs you assign them, with no prices or margins.

text.other: The proposal counts on {needed} crew members and only {assigned} are assigned.

text.other: Sent {count} days ago and still no reply. Resend it or give them a call.
